learning_objective: 🎯 We will explore different festivals we celebrate, the yummy food we eat, and the joy of sharing our happiness!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Festivals are special days when we celebrate with our family and friends. We clean our houses, decorate them beautifully, and feel very happy!
During festivals, we wear bright new clothes and eat delicious sweets made at home. We also share these yummy treats with our neighbors.
Festivals teach us to share, care, and wish good things for everyone. Whether it is Diwali, Eid, Christmas, or Gurpurab, the joy is always the same!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Make a Festival Greeting Card!
fun_activity.instructions: Take a colorful piece of paper, draw stars or lamps, and write Happy Festival to give to your best friend or teacher!

quick_recap: ⭐ Festivals are special days of joy, lights, and happiness.
⭐ We wear new clothes and enjoy eating special tasty sweets.
⭐ Celebrating together teaches us to love and share with everyone.
